status: 0.79.13 OPEN: T2 display-root foundation integrated; no task or acceptance closed
scope: Native GA106 display-root lifetime inside the existing Device and GSP runtime. Passive bootfb remains default; explicit runtime API only.

facts.discovery: Require retained GA106 boot reservation, live graph/session and C670 in the actual RM class list. Static display info uses the firmware-internal client/subdevice, distinct from the display graph. Original C layout is 36 bytes, numDispChannels at32.
facts.allocation: C670 root is allocated under the graph device with zero parameter bytes, matching Nouveau r535. No instance-memory register write, display DMA channel, scanout buffer or mode is created by this checkpoint.
facts.ownership: One embedded stable owner reserves a child name in the existing session namespace and temporarily receives the exact runtime Exchange. Device admission binds owner, request pointer/function and unchanged deadline. Replies publish ownership only after exact transport ACK.
facts.teardown: Before root Free, SET_RMFREE_FLAGS(PRESERVE_HW) must be acknowledged. The one-shot flag is never reused after an uncertain Free attempt; any failure stops the owner. Successful Free releases only RM object/name ownership; the outer boot, VRAM and firmware hold remains retained.
facts.errors: Unsupported class and confirmed allocation rejection unwind only names. Malformed/foreign responses, timeout, failed ACK, preservation failure and failed Free quarantine. Possibly accepted allocations remain explicitly marked and the namespace is retained. Parent graph destruction is blocked until explicit root retirement.
facts.diagnostics: Runtime diagnostics include root/class/head/window/channel information plus failed operation, raw status, confirmed and possible allocation state. Existing fault journal records display-engine failures. No native-output capability or physical-quiescence claim.

validation.reference: Five original-C request/reply pairs, 1136 bytes: class query, internal static info, C670 allocation, preservation control and Free. Full pinned originals and notices archived.
validation.device: Nine scenarios in the existing actual Device group: success with two successive roots, unsupported class, allocation rejection, invalid static geometry, preserve failure, Free failure, ACK failure, timeout and foreign object. Existing dispatch accepts interleaved HPD, rejects copied owner/bytes, changed function/deadline, stale handles and premature parent destruction.
validation.guest: No repeated QEMU run: Kernel, SDK, Contract and common display/queue APIs unchanged.
validation.limits: Software/device model only. Root creation is not visible mode adoption, display DMA execution or safe replacement of instance memory.

sources.notice_normalization: Added notices preserve all text; only trailing whitespace normalized. Full original bytes archived separately. Previous license prefix is byte-identical.

open_software: Boot mode adoption and native instance/context population
Display core/window channels and physical pushbuffer ownership
Own scanout buffers and common presentation consumer
Head/SOR/pixel clock and atomic SDR validation/commit
Pattern confirmation, timer rollback and full before/after recovery diagnosis
